relevance_note: Case series of four children with TNFAIP3 variants: "We describe four unrelated patients evaluated at a single tertiary center, each carrying a distinct TNFAIP3 mutation".
method_note: Read the full paper; rows written by hand into a Python builder script (no automatic table transcription); spans checked verbatim by script. Labels A-D follow Table 1's Patient column and the text ("Patient A", Case 1-4). Relatives included when described as affected or tested: A's paternal and maternal aunts (oral ulcers); B's father (same variant), paternal grandfather (HA20), paternal great-grandmother and one brother (oral ulcers); C's maternal aunt (died of lupus); D's parents (tested negative). Left out as neither tested nor affected by the disease features: A's unaffected brother and sister with neurodevelopmental delay, B's mother and other brother, C's two unaffected sisters, D's brother (anxiety and epilepsy). Previously published people from the Discussion with individual-level facts were given 'ref (...) patient' rows: (15, 16) male with p.Pro247Leu; (2, 12, 22) female with oral ulcers and uveitis, attributed to p.Arg271* from sentence context; (24) patient with p.Trp168*, HA20 and DLBCL; (26) male HA20 patient with p.Q379* plus his mother and grandmother diagnosed with Behcet's. The sentence about ref (24) says the HA20+DLBCL combination is 'as found in the father of patient B (24)'; the paper does not say B's father is that published patient, so they are separate rows and cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is left null. Pathogenicity for B, C, D and the literature rows comes from the Discussion's statements about each exact protein variant (two cite ClinVar RCV numbers). Variant type 'non-sense' is stated only for unnamed groups ('Three out of four patients had non-sense mutations'), so B, C, D variant types are 'not reported'. Not recorded as features: normal CXR/ECG in B's ED workup (a later CXR showed pleural effusions), D's normal sinus and pulmonary CT (whole investigations), D's CRP of 60.9 mg/L (not called elevated), A's Smith IgG 23.1 units, C's stool calprotectin of 199 mcg/g and HLA B51 negative (not called abnormal/phenotype). Checklist 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation' left not reported for A although uveitis and retinal vasculitis were negative (narrower absence). B's biopsies 'without clear' IBD recorded as excluded features but the GI checklist item left not reported. Father of B's 'aphthous ulcers' and 'significant cutaneous findings' not mapped to oral ulcers / skin lesions checklist items (site/type unspecified); DLBCL not mapped to lymphoproliferation. No stacked cells; no contradictions found.
